flags.note: Extended — 95% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -2% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.

flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.

threats.evidence: Net profit 115 -> 138 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow -6 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -282 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.92 pp, DII -1.41 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The company's business is subject to risks from the performance of the Indian and international economies.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets" (concall ppt - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The gold import duty has been raised back to 15%.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Talking about the gold price duty, gold duty was initially set at 15%, later reduced to 6%, and has now been raised again to 15%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Managing over 1,300 companies leads to erratic payment schedules and cash flow challenges.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Currently, since I work with over 1,300 companies, managing them all is challenging; their payment schedules can be erratic, sometimes early, sometimes late, which can lead to a disruptive churning effect on our cash flow." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)
